newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish airport ground handling firm to go public.
newsitem.headline: Turkish airport ground handling firm to go public.

text.p: Shares representing 15 percent capital of Turkish airport ground handling firm Celebi Hava Servisi A.S will be offered to the public on November 7-8.
The price per 1,000 lira nominal value will be fixed at 21,000 lira. Each share will have a 10,000 lira face value, the company said.

Celebi will offer a total of 37.5 billion lira of shares out of its 250 billion lira capital. 20 billion lira of the total offer will be allocated to foreign institutional investors and one billion lira to company staff.
Domestic institutional investors will be able to buy up to 2.5 billion lira worth shares from the foreign institutions' part.
The consortium which will manage the offer is led by T.Sinai Kalkinma Bankasi and co-led by T.Is Bankasi.
Celebi posted net profits of 257.31 billion lira and 2.24 trillion lira of net sales in the first half of 1996, after 464.25 billion lira and 3.64 trillion lira, respectively in the whole of 1995.
